pages.text: Lots of shells lay where the waves had receded. Riri and Lolo crouched down.
They wanted to hear the sea through the biggest spiral shell. "A big one will make a bigger sound, right?"
Riri held small shells to her ear first. Lolo looked around for a big one. "We have to listen to all of them to know." "We just need to find the big one."
Shells Riri had tried piled up in front of her. Ten, twenty, thirty.
Sand inside the shells scratched against her ear. Riri shook it out.
Lolo grabbed the biggest shell and held it to their ear.
Legs poked out of the shell. A hermit crab lived inside! Lolo dropped it.
The hermit crab peered into Lolo's boot. Lolo quickly pulled their foot out.
The hermit crab slipped into another shell nearby. The big shell was empty.
They held the big shell to their ears. Whoosh—the sound of the sea! Beside them, the hermit crab walked sideways, carrying its new home.
